class Rulings:
    identity = "synthetic-epoch-fixture"

    def __init__(self):
        self.calls = []

    def __call__(self, payload, schema):
        bank = payload["bank"]
        assert set(schema["properties"]) == {bank}
        assert bank not in payload["known"]
        self.calls.append((payload["entry_id"], bank))
        return json.dumps({bank: 1 if bank == "QUANTITY" else 0})



def native(lemma, ancestor):
    synset = lemma + ".n.01"
    identity = f"wordnet:{lemma}:{synset}"
    definition = Definition(identity, lemma, "noun", f"Synthetic measurement {lemma}.")
    observation = Observation(
        identity,
        "wordnet_hierarchy",
        identity,
        "wordnet",
        {
            "lemma": lemma,
            "pos": "noun",
            "definition": definition.definition,
            "synset_name": synset,
            "lemma_names": [lemma],
            "hypernym_paths": [["entity.n.01", ancestor, synset]],
        },
        "lexical",
        (identity,),
    )
    return definition, observation


def family(name, ancestor, left, right, audit):
    return {
        "id": name,
        **({"premises": left} if isinstance(left[0], list) else {"antecedent": left}),
        "consequent": right,
        "guards": [["pos", "noun"], ["wordnet_native_lemma", "true"], [f"wordnet_ancestor:{ancestor}", "true"]],
        "holdouts": [f"wordnet:{audit}:{audit}.n.01"],
        "warrant": {
            "kind": "DEFINITIONAL_DERIVATION",
            "warrant_id": name,
            "review_id": name,
            "reviewer": "synthetic-test",
            "source_refs": ["synthetic:epoch"],
            "statement": "Synthetic assignments establish the workflow contract.",
        },
    }


def test_two_generations_replay_and_resume_at_equal_budget(tmp_path):
    base, active = tmp_path / "base.db", tmp_path / "active.json"
    active.write_text("{}")
    durations = [native(word, "time_unit.n.01") for word in ("day", "minute", "hour", "second")]
    areas = [native(word, "area_unit.n.01") for word in ("are", "acre")]
    definitions, observations = zip(*durations, *areas)
    assertions = tuple(
        Assertion("SOMETHING", 1, "wordnet_hierarchy", definition.entry_id, "wordnet") for definition in definitions
    )
    manifest = tmp_path / "rules.json"
    manifest.write_text(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "format": "GSE.lexicon-rules/1",
                "relations": [
                    {
                        "rule_id": "synthetic-area-quantity",
                        "banks": ["QUANTITY"],
                        "allowed_rows": [[1]],
                        "provenance": ["synthetic:epoch"],
                        "authority": "conditional",
                        "approved": True,
                        "guards": [["wordnet_ancestor:area_unit.n.01", "true"]],
                    }
                ],
            }
        )
    )
    build_dictionary(EvidenceBundle(definitions, observations, assertions, ()), base, manifest=manifest)
    plan = {
        "format": "GSE.lexicon-epoch-plan/1",
        "baseline_sha256": fingerprint(base),
        "active_pointer_sha256": fingerprint(active),
        "epochs": 2,
        "audits_per_epoch": 1,
        "families": [
            family("duration-quantity", "time_unit.n.01", ["SOMETHING", 1], ["QUANTITY", 1], "second"),
            family("duration-want", "time_unit.n.01", [["QUANTITY", 1], ["SOMETHING", 1]], ["WANT", 0], "hour"),
            family("area-body", "area_unit.n.01", ["QUANTITY", 1], ["BODY", 0], "acre"),
        ],
    }
    population = census(base, parse_plan(plan))
    record(tmp_path / "inventory.json", population)
    arms = {}
    for policy in ("closure", "zipf"):
        model = Rulings()
        args = (plan, base, active, tmp_path / policy, population, policy, model, tmp_path / "model.lock")
        arms[policy] = run_arm(*args)
        assert arms[policy]["typed_questions_used"] == 4 == len(model.calls)
        assert arms[policy]["replay"]["code"] == "REPLAY_VALIDATED"
        assert run_arm(*args) == arms[policy]
        assert len(model.calls) == 4
    assert [e["selected"]["family"] for e in arms["closure"]["epochs"]] == ["duration-quantity", "duration-want"]
    assert [e["selected"]["family"] for e in arms["zipf"]["epochs"]] == ["area-body", "duration-quantity"]
    assert arms["closure"]["epochs"][1]["premise_depends_on"] == arms["closure"]["admitted"][:1]
    assert arms["closure"]["new_cells"] == 8
    assert arms["zipf"]["new_cells"] == 6
    result = compare(tmp_path, plan)
    assert result["code"] == "EQUAL_BUDGET_FEEDBACK_VALIDATED"
    assert result["closure_minus_zipf_new_cells"] == 2
    assert result["second_generation_rules"][0]["interactions"][0]["joint_only"] == 4
    grounding = json.loads((tmp_path / "closure" / "grounded-chains-final.json").read_text())
    assert any(
        len(rule["rule_ids"]) == 2 and rule["consequent"] == ["WANT", 0] and len(rule["witnesses"]) == 4
        for rule in grounding["proposals"]
    )
    assert fingerprint(base) == plan["baseline_sha256"]
    assert fingerprint(active) == plan["active_pointer_sha256"]

def test_open_bank_discovery_review_audit_and_replay_resume_under_the_same_plan(tmp_path):
    from GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.learning_curriculum import REVIEW_FORMAT
    from GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.learning_state import LearningState

    base, pointer, plan, inventory = open_curriculum_inputs(tmp_path)
    directory, model = tmp_path / "learner", Rulings()
    args = (plan, base, pointer, directory, inventory, "closure", model, tmp_path / "model.lock")
    first = run_arm(*args)
    assert first["code"] == "LEARNING_REVIEW_REQUIRED"
    assert first["typed_questions_used"] == 1 == len(model.calls)
    [epoch] = first["epochs"]
    assert epoch["selected"]["task"] == "OPEN_BANK_TEACHING" and epoch["selected"]["family"] is None
    assert epoch["teaching"]["proposal_outcome"] == "NO_PROPOSED_ANSWER"
    assert first["admitted"] == [] and first["new_cells"] == 1
    [pending] = first["learning_state"]["pending"]
    assert pending["disposition"] == "AWAITING_WARRANT"
    assert pending["contract"]["banks"] == ["QUANTITY"]
    assert not (directory / "arm-result.json").exists()
    assert run_arm(*args) == first and len(model.calls) == 1
    item = family("learned-unit-quantity", "time_unit.n.01", ["SOMETHING", 1], ["QUANTITY", 1], "beta")
    item.update(antecedent=None, holdouts=["wordnet:beta:beta.n.01", "wordnet:gamma:gamma.n.01"])
    (directory / "reviews.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "format": REVIEW_FORMAT,
                "records": [{"mechanism_id": pending["mechanism_id"], "family": item}],
            }
        )
    )
    result = run_arm(*args)
    assert result["epochs"][1]["code"] == "RULE_ADMITTED"
    assert result["epochs"][1]["selected"]["task"] == "AUDIT_DISCOVERED_MECHANISM"
    assert result["typed_questions_used"] == len(model.calls) == 3
    assert model.calls.count(("wordnet:alpha:alpha.n.01", "QUANTITY")) == 1
    assert result["new_cells"] == 4 and result["reopened_cells"] == 0
    assert result["replay"]["code"] == "REPLAY_VALIDATED" and result["replay"]["complete_search"]
    assert result["epochs"][1]["specification_learning"]["rule_revision"]["lexicon"]["specification_gain_bits"] > 0
    with sqlite3.connect(result["candidate"]) as conn:
        for (encoded,) in conn.execute("SELECT domains FROM definition_states"):
            domains = json.loads(encoded)
            assert domains["QUANTITY"] == [1] and domains["THINK"] == [-1, 0, 1]
    assert result["learning_state"]["pending"] == []
    (directory / "reviews.json").unlink()  # Durable reviews are independent of the intake file.
    assert run_arm(*args) == result and len(model.calls) == 3
    state = LearningState(directory / "learning.sqlite", json.loads((directory / "arm.json").read_text()))
    assert state.reviewed()[0]["disposition"] == "ADMITTED"
    assert fingerprint(base) == plan["baseline_sha256"]
    assert fingerprint(pointer) == plan["active_pointer_sha256"]


"""Count the actual factorized specification space, alongside lexical coverage.

The existing solver supplies exhaustive component witness counts. Marginal
domains alone cannot recover those counts. This module never supplies signs,
approves rules, or treats an unfinished search as an empty/settled space.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import math
import sqlite3
import unicodedata
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from contextlib import closing
from pathlib import Path

from GSE.namespace import identity_form

FORMAT = "GSE.specification-space/1"
CONTRACT = "GSE.ssl-construction/2"
BUCKETS = ("1-500", "501-1500", "1501-5000", "5001+", "unranked")


def measure_space(domains, trace, *, conflicted=False):
    """Count complete bank assignments from disjoint, exhaustively solved factors."""
    if not isinstance(domains, dict) or not domains:
        raise ValueError("SPECIFICATION_DOMAINS_REQUIRED")
    for name, values in domains.items():
        if not isinstance(name, str) or not name or not isinstance(values, (list, tuple, set, frozenset)):
            raise ValueError("INVALID_SPECIFICATION_DOMAIN")
        if any(type(value) is not int or value not in (-1, 0, 1) for value in values):
            raise ValueError("INVALID_SPECIFICATION_TRIT")
        if len(set(values)) != len(values):
            raise ValueError("DUPLICATE_SPECIFICATION_TRIT")
    conflict = conflicted or any(not values for values in domains.values())
    filled = sum(len(values) == 1 for values in domains.values())
    result = {
        "code": "CONFLICT" if conflict else "EXACT",
        "banks": len(domains),
        "filled_banks": filled,
        "explicit_zero_banks": sum(list(values) == [0] for values in domains.values()),
        "unresolved_banks": sum(len(values) > 1 for values in domains.values()),
        "possible_assignments": None,
        "specification_bits": None,
        "domain_potential_bits": None if conflict else math.fsum(math.log2(len(v)) for v in domains.values()),
        "upper_bound_bits": None,
        "limited_components": 0,
    }
    if conflict:
        result["possible_assignments"] = 0
        return result
    scopes = [row for row in trace if row.get("kind") == "INFERENCE_SCOPE"]
    if len(scopes) != 1:
        result["code"] = "MISSING_SOLVER_CERTIFICATE"
        result["upper_bound_bits"] = result["domain_potential_bits"]
        return result
    covered, factors = set(), []
    limited = 0
    for receipt in trace:
        if receipt.get("kind") not in ("JOINT_CHECK", "SOLVER_LIMIT"):
            continue
        names = receipt["banks"]
        if len(set(names)) != len(names) or not set(names) <= domains.keys() or covered.intersection(names):
            raise ValueError("SPECIFICATION_FACTORS_NOT_DISJOINT")
        covered.update(names)
        upper = math.prod(len(domains[name]) for name in names)
        if receipt["kind"] == "SOLVER_LIMIT":
            limited += 1
            factors.append(upper)
        else:
            count = receipt["witnesses"]
            if type(count) is not int or not 1 <= count <= upper:
                raise ValueError("INVALID_SPECIFICATION_WITNESS_COUNT")
            factors.append(count)
    factors.extend(len(values) for name, values in domains.items() if name not in covered)
    count = math.prod(factors)
    result["upper_bound_bits"] = math.log2(count)
    result["limited_components"] = limited
    if limited or not scopes[0].get("complete_search") or scopes[0].get("satisfiability") != "SATISFIABLE":
        result["code"] = "SOLVER_LIMIT" if limited else "INCOMPLETE_SOLVER_CERTIFICATE"
    else:
        result["possible_assignments"] = count
        result["specification_bits"] = math.log2(count)
    return result


def measure_resolution(resolution):
    """Consume the production resolver's domains and proof, without re-solving."""
    return measure_space(resolution.domains, resolution.trace, conflicted=resolution.code == "CONFLICT")


def space_delta(before, after):
    """Keep exact contraction, marginal narrowing, reopening and limits distinct."""
    exact = before["code"] == after["code"] == "EXACT"
    bits = before["specification_bits"] - after["specification_bits"] if exact else None
    return {
        "code": "CONTRACTION"
        if bits is not None and bits > 0
        else "EXPANSION"
        if bits is not None and bits < 0
        else "UNCHANGED"
        if exact
        else "UNAVAILABLE",
        "specification_gain_bits": bits,
        "removed_assignments": before["possible_assignments"] - after["possible_assignments"] if exact else None,
        "domain_potential_gain_bits": (
            before["domain_potential_bits"] - after["domain_potential_bits"]
            if before["domain_potential_bits"] is not None and after["domain_potential_bits"] is not None
            else None
        ),
        "net_filled_banks": after["filled_banks"] - before["filled_banks"],
    }


def normalized_spelling(word):
    """Share canonical spelling identity without claiming same-sense identity."""
    return unicodedata.normalize("NFC", word).strip().casefold()


def frequency_buckets(spellings, frequencies):
    """Rank corpus spellings, retaining zero/absent-frequency words separately."""
    words = {normalized_spelling(word) for word in spellings}
    ranked = sorted(
        (word for word in words if frequencies.get(word, 0) > 0), key=lambda word: (-frequencies[word], word)
    )
    result = dict.fromkeys(words, "unranked")
    for rank, word in enumerate(ranked, 1):
        result[word] = (
            "1-500" if rank <= 500 else "501-1500" if rank <= 1500 else "1501-5000" if rank <= 5000 else "5001+"
        )
    return result


def _aggregate(records):
    counts = Counter(
        dict.fromkeys(
            ("definitions", "filled_banks", "explicit_zero_banks", "unresolved_banks", "banks", "limited_components"), 0
        )
    )
    exact_bits, marginal, upper = [], [], []
    spellings = defaultdict(lambda: [0, 0])
    histogram = Counter()
    for spelling, state in records:
        counts["definitions"] += 1
        counts[state["code"]] += 1
        for key in ("filled_banks", "explicit_zero_banks", "unresolved_banks", "banks", "limited_components"):
            counts[key] += state[key]
        spellings[spelling][0] += state["unresolved_banks"]
        spellings[spelling][1] += 1
        if state["specification_bits"] is not None:
            exact_bits.append(state["specification_bits"])
            histogram[str(state["possible_assignments"])] += 1
        if state["domain_potential_bits"] is not None:
            marginal.append(state["domain_potential_bits"])
        if state["upper_bound_bits"] is not None:
            upper.append(state["upper_bound_bits"])
    n = counts["definitions"]
    return {
        **dict(counts),
        "spellings": len(spellings),
        "mean_unresolved_banks_per_definition": counts["unresolved_banks"] / n if n else None,
        "spelling_weighted_mean_unresolved_banks": math.fsum(total / senses for total, senses in spellings.values())
        / len(spellings)
        if spellings
        else None,
        "specification_bits": math.fsum(exact_bits) if counts["EXACT"] == n and n else None,
        "exact_subset_specification_bits": math.fsum(exact_bits),
        "exact_definitions": counts["EXACT"],
        "domain_potential_bits": math.fsum(marginal),
        "upper_bound_bits": math.fsum(upper) if len(upper) == n and n else None,
        "assignment_count_histogram": dict(sorted(histogram.items(), key=lambda item: int(item[0]))),
        "joint_assignment_count_representation": "PRODUCT_OF_EACH_HISTOGRAM_BASE_RAISED_TO_ITS_COUNT",
        "joint_assignment_product_complete": counts["EXACT"] == n and n > 0,
    }


def measure_dictionary(path, frequency_path=None):
    """Read one consistent whole-corpus snapshot; write no database or checkpoint."""
    from .catalog import SENTENCE_DURATION_SOURCE_RECORD
    from .completion import _priority_source

    path = Path(path).resolve(strict=True)
    frequency, frequencies = _priority_source("zipf", frequency_path)
    groups = defaultdict(list)
    cohort = hashlib.sha256()
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(path.as_uri() + "?mode=ro", uri=True)) as conn:
        conn.execute("BEGIN")
        metadata = dict(conn.execute("SELECT key,value FROM builder_metadata WHERE key IN ('rule_version','format')"))
        names = [
            row[0]
            for row in conn.execute(
                "SELECT DISTINCT l.lemma FROM definition_states d JOIN lexemes l ON l.id=d.lexeme_id WHERE d.entry_id != ?",
                (SENTENCE_DURATION_SOURCE_RECORD,),
            )
        ]
        buckets = frequency_buckets(names, frequencies)
        query = "SELECT d.entry_id,l.lemma,l.pos,d.code,d.domains,d.trace FROM definition_states d JOIN lexemes l ON l.id=d.lexeme_id ORDER BY d.entry_id"
        for identity, lemma, pos, code, domains, trace in conn.execute(query):
            cohort.update(json.dumps(identity, ensure_ascii=False).encode() + b"\n")
            spelling = normalized_spelling(lemma)
            state = measure_space(json.loads(domains), json.loads(trace), conflicted=code == "CONFLICT")
            groups[
                "sentence_constructions" if identity == SENTENCE_DURATION_SOURCE_RECORD else buckets[spelling]
            ].append((spelling, state))
    lexical = [record for name in BUCKETS for record in groups[name]]
    return {
        "format": FORMAT,
        "contract": CONTRACT,
        "path": str(path),
        "cohort_sha256": cohort.hexdigest(),
        "rule_version": metadata.get("rule_version"),
        "frequency": frequency,
        "frequency_semantics": "SPELLING_RANK_NOT_SENSE_FREQUENCY",
        "count_semantics": "PRODUCT_OF_EXHAUSTIVE_COMPONENT_COUNTS_AND_FREE_DOMAINS",
        "measurement_scope": "PERSISTED_SOLVER_RECEIPTS_NOT_A_NEW_SEMANTIC_VALIDATION",
        "lexicon": _aggregate(lexical),
        "buckets": {name: _aggregate(groups[name]) for name in BUCKETS},
        "sentence_constructions": _aggregate(groups["sentence_constructions"]),
    }


def compare_measurements(before, after):
    """Compare a fixed cohort and frequency policy; never reward a changed target."""
    if any(
        identity_form(before.get(key)) != identity_form(after.get(key))
        for key in ("format", "contract", "cohort_sha256", "frequency")
    ):
        raise ValueError("SPECIFICATION_MEASUREMENT_POPULATION_CHANGED")

    def difference(left, right):
        if left["definitions"] != right["definitions"] or left["banks"] != right["banks"]:
            raise ValueError("SPECIFICATION_MEASUREMENT_BASIS_CHANGED")
        exact = left["specification_bits"] is not None and right["specification_bits"] is not None
        return {
            "net_filled_banks": right["filled_banks"] - left["filled_banks"],
            "unresolved_banks_reduction": left["unresolved_banks"] - right["unresolved_banks"],
            "specification_gain_bits": left["specification_bits"] - right["specification_bits"] if exact else None,
            "domain_potential_gain_bits": left["domain_potential_bits"] - right["domain_potential_bits"],
            "joint_count_comparison": "EXACT" if exact else "UNAVAILABLE",
        }

    return {
        "lexicon": difference(before["lexicon"], after["lexicon"]),
        "buckets": {name: difference(before["buckets"][name], after["buckets"][name]) for name in BUCKETS},
        "sentence_constructions": difference(before["sentence_constructions"], after["sentence_constructions"]),
    }
